leads.name: Freundschaftseiche in Rudolstadt

location.address: Platz der Opfer des Faschismus, Rudolstadt

leads.verify_notes: Planted 3 October 2015 on the Platz der Opfer des Faschismus, commemorating Rudolstadt's city partnership with Bayreuth. A young red oak (about 11 years old), not remarkable on its own merits yet. Coordinates from the given lead, consistent with a Commons photo location for the same square. Only ~250m from the Einheitslinde. GOOD CANDIDATE to revisit in a few decades, or if a third/fourth Rudolstadt tree turns up.

leads.name: Einheitslinde in Rudolstadt

location.address: Forecourt of the Thueringer Landestheater, Rudolstadt

leads.verify_notes: Planted 3 October 1990, the day of German reunification, on the forecourt of the Thueringer Landestheater. A memorial stone of Thuringian slate marking the city partnership with Bayreuth was added 2 October 2010. A civic reunification memorial tree, not remarkable on size or age; species only identified to genus (Tilia sp., following the lead file's own basis). About 250m from the Freundschaftseiche. GOOD CANDIDATE to revisit in a few decades, or if a third/fourth Rudolstadt tree turns up.
leads.access: Free, public square in front of the theatre.
